content: The great pillar to the sky should not have been damaged by such tiny bombs, but some of its roots peel back, hanging down towards the miniscule people aboard the ship, providing a route from the deck to the base of the tower.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Let's go! Quickly!

raw: You climb the fallen structures with all haste.
content: You climb the fallen structures with all haste.

raw: To your surprise, the white material feels soft and pliant, almost like some sort of... cloth.
content: To your surprise, the white material feels soft and pliant, almost like some sort of... cloth.
Amiya touches the 'roots' lightly.

raw: In an instant, countless hands stretch towards her. From the sea, from atop the tower, from the void.
content: In an instant, countless hands stretch towards her. From the sea, from atop the tower, from the void.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="Close your eyes, Amiya.", x=300,y=300, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n\nClose your eyes...",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="The King spurs them, the King drives them, the King enslaves them.", x=300,y=300, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: The King spurs them, the King drives them, the King enslaves them.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n\nThe King rules us, the King leads us, the King inspires us.",block = true)]
text: \n\nThe King rules us, the King leads us, the King inspires us.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="You have arrived.", x=300,y=300, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n\nYou are among us.",block = true)]

speaker: Amiya
content: The myriad souls...

raw: The Originium sea is close to boiling.
content: The Originium sea is close to boiling.

raw: The myriad souls thirst for the King of Sarkaz. The myriad souls wish to force the King of Sarkaz to stay.
content: The myriad souls thirst for the King of Sarkaz. The myriad souls wish to force the King of Sarkaz to stay.

speaker: Logos
content: Go on ahead, Amiya.

raw: [name="Logos"]Go and see Her Highness. Obtain the answers you seek, and overcome them.
speaker: Logos
content: Go and see Her Highness. Obtain the answers you seek, and overcome them.

speaker: Amiya
content: Logos...?

speaker: Logos
content: I also miss Her Highness.

raw: [name="Logos"]But we have long since bid farewell to her.
speaker: Logos
content: But we have long since bid farewell to her.

raw: [name="Logos"]When Babel still yet roamed the earth, the first circle of our fellows vowed to dedicate our lives in service of our ideals. Her Highness and I were no exception.
speaker: Logos
content: When Babel still yet roamed the earth, the first circle of our fellows vowed to dedicate our lives in service of our ideals. Her Highness and I were no exception.

raw: [name="Logos"]As for the voices of the myriad souls... I will respond.
speaker: Logos
content: As for the voices of the myriad souls... I will respond.

raw: [name="Logos"]I have been waiting for this moment, ever since I sang my first elegy.
speaker: Logos
content: I have been waiting for this moment, ever since I sang my first elegy.

raw: [ImageTween(xFrom=-40, yFrom=-30, xTo=0, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1, duration=25, block=false)]
The will of the myriad souls is a frothing sea, billowing furiously.
content: The will of the myriad souls is a frothing sea, billowing furiously.

raw: Their hands clench swords. Their hands leash Feranmuts. Their hands command a thousand armies.
content: Their hands clench swords. Their hands leash Feranmuts. Their hands command a thousand armies.
Their heads bear identical crowns.

raw: They are the lords of the Sarkaz.
content: They are the lords of the Sarkaz.

raw: They are the eternal existence of the Sarkaz.
content: They are the eternal existence of the Sarkaz.

raw: [name="'Nameless Kings of Sarkaz'"]There are no roads that we have not walked, no hardships we have not shouldered.
speaker: 'Nameless Kings of Sarkaz'
content: There are no roads that we have not walked, no hardships we have not shouldered.

raw: [name="'Nameless Kings of Sarkaz'"]You have not the strength to match us.
speaker: 'Nameless Kings of Sarkaz'
content: You have not the strength to match us.

raw: [name="'Nameless Kings of Sarkaz'"]You have not the fearlessness to match us.
speaker: 'Nameless Kings of Sarkaz'
content: You have not the fearlessness to match us.
They examine, they interrogate.

raw: Countless fleeting emotions condense into a raging swell, enough to wash away any will of any individual.
content: Countless fleeting emotions condense into a raging swell, enough to wash away any will of any individual.

raw: But through a hundred crashing, surging waves, then a thousand, then a million, the one before them stands firm.
content: But through a hundred crashing, surging waves, then a thousand, then a million, the one before them stands firm.

raw: The young Sarkaz lifts his bone pen, pointing it towards all the nameless Kings of Sarkaz.
content: The young Sarkaz lifts his bone pen, pointing it towards all the nameless Kings of Sarkaz.
He needs no words.
His curses are his answer.
